package ap

// ddsonic contract helper. This file exists only in the overlay the contract
// runner builds over a staged copy of go-librespot; it is in no real copy of
// the SDK and in no ddsonic build. It makes an access point over a connection
// a test supplies, by setting the package's own fields, so that tests in
// this package and in package audio can stall it deterministically.

import (
	"net"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
)

// DDSonicContractAP is an access point over conn that has not started its
// receive loop.
func DDSonicContractAP(conn net.Conn) *Accesspoint {
	a := NewAccesspoint(&librespot.NullLogger{}, nil, "")
	a.conn = conn
	a.encConn = newShannonConn(conn, make([]byte, 32), make([]byte, 32))
	a.recvLoopOnce.Do(func() {})
	return a
}
